01_root_cause_and_selected_fix.root_cause: The worked example had become a separate persistent planning subsystem with its own dashboard cards, editor, calculations, save/print lifecycle and branches in shared route, Float Plan, Follow, Captain, map and PDF paths. Removing only its service or cards would leave shared dependencies broken.

01_root_cause_and_selected_fix.safest_fix_comparison: The narrower option was to retire runtime dependencies while retaining the obsolete metadata table. The user selected archive/conversion followed by removal of guide_route_imports instead.
01_root_cause_and_selected_fix.preserved: Bahamas article and Cruising Guides, dark styles and images, ordinary route behavior/improvements, auth safeguards, public rewrites and existing HTTP security blocks.

06_reused_creation_methods.transaction: All source/waypoint/leg/override/generation writes occur inside one import transaction and the existing member-row lock. A failed creation result throws; injected late generation failure rolled back source writes and product events.
06_reused_creation_methods.idempotency: Per-member/request serialization and completed response retained in the existing session intent. Same valid operation returns the same route. A new operation with the canonical route name is a conflict, not a numbered copy.
